findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tolk2go_search_support_knowledge" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the approved Tolk2Go FAQ knowledge base. Translate the user's question to English before calling this tool. Use it before answering questions about booki…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
